# Popoto

> Agent memory on Redis and Valkey, as primitives you program rather than a
> service you call. Records decay over time, confidence moves with evidence,
> associations form between co-mentioned things, and a context assembler packs
> the result into a token budget before each LLM turn. It runs in your process
> against a Redis or Valkey server you already operate: three packages, no API
> key, no hosted service. Underneath it is a full Redis/Valkey ORM with
> Django-like model syntax, so every memory primitive is a field on an ordinary
> model.

## Start here

- [Home](https://popoto.io/): the memory loop in six lines, and what is measured
- [Agent Memory Quickstart](https://popoto.io/guides/agent-memory-quickstart/): six progressive levels, from one decaying field to full assembly
- [SubconsciousMemory Recipe](https://popoto.io/guides/subconscious-memory-recipe/): inject before the LLM call, extract after, report outcomes
- [Query-Blind Retrieval](https://popoto.io/guides/query-blind-retrieval/): when composite ranking is right and when it silently costs you the answer
- [LLM Memory Extraction](https://popoto.io/features/llm-memory-extraction/): pluggable extraction providers, and the measurement showing extraction lost to raw ingestion

## Understand and tune

- [Agent Memory Overview](https://popoto.io/features/agent-memory/): the 17 primitives, the layers composed on them, and how they fit together
- [DecayingSortedField](https://popoto.io/features/decaying-sorted-field/): time-decayed scoring, confidence-modulated decay
- [CyclicDecayField](https://popoto.io/features/cyclic-decay-field/): temporal rhythms and homeostatic pressure
- [ConfidenceField](https://popoto.io/features/confidence-field/): capped-evidence Bayesian certainty
- [CoOccurrenceField](https://popoto.io/features/co-occurrence-field/): weighted association edges and BFS propagation
- [Hybrid Retrieval (BM25 + RRF)](https://popoto.io/features/hybrid-retrieval/): keyword, vector, and graph signals fused by weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion
- [ContextAssembler](https://popoto.io/features/context-assembler/): retrieval modes, token budgets, confidence gate, graph traversal
- [Composite Score Query](https://popoto.io/features/composite-score-query/): multi-signal server-side ranking
- [ExistenceFilter](https://popoto.io/features/existence-filter/): Bloom-style membership pre-check
- [ObservationProtocol](https://popoto.io/features/observation-protocol/): acted, dismissed, deferred, contradicted, used
- [ValidityField and SupersessionProtocol](https://popoto.io/features/validity-and-supersession/): bitemporal validity intervals and supersession chains — validity decides membership, decay decides ordering
- [PredictionLedger](https://popoto.io/features/prediction-ledger/): predictions, outcomes, and error feedback into confidence
- [PolicyCache](https://popoto.io/features/policy-cache/): reinforcement-learning-style action selection
- [Metacognitive Layer](https://popoto.io/features/metacognitive-layer/): retrieval-quality scoring and the adaptive assembler
- [NeverRecordFirewall](https://popoto.io/features/never-record-firewall/): deterministic pre-storage privacy gate that blocks credentials, keys, and other secrets before they reach Redis
- [Tuning Magic Numbers](https://popoto.io/guides/tuning-magic-numbers/): every behavioral constant and its empirical basis
- [Parametric Sweep](https://popoto.io/features/parametric-sweep/): the harness that tunes those constants

## Benchmarks and method

- [Benchmarks Overview](https://popoto.io/benchmarks/results/): result pages generated at build time from committed artifacts
- [Method and How-To](https://popoto.io/benchmarks/): every harness, the pinned judge protocol, the granularity disclosures, and the results that came out badly

## Redis and Valkey ORM

- [Configuration](https://popoto.io/configuration/): REDIS_URL, defaults, runtime knobs
- [Models and Fields](https://popoto.io/fields/): every field type, mixin, and model method
- [Making Queries](https://popoto.io/query/): filtering, get, get_many, semantic_search
- [Model Meta Options](https://popoto.io/meta/): `class Meta` configuration
- [TTL (Time-to-Live)](https://popoto.io/ttl/): key expiration
- [Indexed Fields](https://popoto.io/indexed_fields/): sorted, unique, and geo indexes
- [Relationship Field](https://popoto.io/relationship/): linking models
- [Multi-Tenancy](https://popoto.io/multi-tenancy/): tenant isolation via KeyField namespacing
- [Async Operations](https://popoto.io/async/): async/await support across the API
- [PubSub](https://popoto.io/pubsub/): publisher/subscriber for streaming updates
- [Content & Embeddings](https://popoto.io/features/content-and-embedding-fields/): filesystem content storage and vector embeddings
- [Recipes](https://popoto.io/recipes/): bulk operations, index maintenance, MemoryLifecycle, StreamConsumer
